endpoint: Seven-day quantile pinball, arithmetic mean across matched eligible contract-origin cells
missingness: Truth must match exact frozen contract. Use the common truth-resolved cohort across all registered methods; inference failures retain persistence and failure flags. Do not exclude failed predictions.

uncertainty.unit: entire weekly origin, all its contracts and methods together
uncertainty.method: circular moving-block bootstrap of origins, paired contrasts
uncertainty.resampling_rule: Sample uniformly chosen contiguous circular origin blocks until n origins, truncate to n; retain each sampled origin's sum of paired cell differences and cell count; divide summed losses by summed counts
uncertainty.limitations: Sixteen dependent origins may be weakly informative. Intervals are a dependence-sensitivity diagnostic, not a guarantee of nominal coverage.

promotion: No automatic promotion and no repeated significance tests. Publish all paired estimates, both block sensitivities, coverage, widths, MAE, failures and effective temporal coverage. Inconclusive stays inconclusive.
future_followup: Any later challenger or panel extension requires a separate registration before issuance
